thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 streaming latency breach detected on pool-gpu-shared-7. route=/v1/stream_response p95=420ms p99=1240ms (SLO p99=800ms). Pager fired to @oncall.

sara: seeing spike in KV cache misses for tenant=alpha-sim, eviction rate jumped ~3.5x in last 10m. correlates with streaming stalls.

aj: jumping on node metrics now. running `iostat -x 1 3` and `nvme top` to check NVMe writeback.

aj: ```
# iostat -x 1 3
Device:         r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s rrqm/s wrqm/s r_await w_await aqu-sz  %util
nvme0n1       12.3   310.5  1024.0 51200.0   0.00  12.00   2.1    28.9   0.05  96.3
```

aj: blkio queues are saturated, write_latency spikes to ~200ms. this would amplify tail latency for small random writes (kv cache writeback).

mike: sounds like eviction -> writeback -> blkio contention -> stall in streaming path when cache misses require disk fetch. multi-tenant noisy writer probably thrashing.

elena: which tenants on pool-gpu-shared-7? can we identify the noisy writer and isolate?

aj: top offenders by write_bytes in last 5m: alpha-sim (45%), gamma-bench (30%), misc (rest). alpha-sim is the biggest.

oncall: paging alpha-sim owner to assess running jobs and any recent changes. @sara can you confirm if config changed?

sara: no recent config changes from alpha-sim on our side. they do a nightly batch that sometimes overlaps but timing shifted. looks like heavy batch started ~12:07 UTC.

mike: mitigation options: 1) throttle alpha-sim blkio weight 2) move alpha-sim to an isolated pool (preferred) 3) temporarily disable background writeback/flush frequency for node (risky).

elena: starting live mitigation: creating evict/migrate job for alpha-sim to dedicated-pool-3. running command: 
```
./scheduler migrate --tenant alpha-sim --from pool-gpu-shared-7 --to dedicated-pool-3 --live
```

elena: migration kicked. ETA ~90s for in-flight connections to drain.

deploy-bot: migration job 7634 started by elena. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/7634

mike: while migration in progress, also applying soft blkio throttle so other tenants see reduced variance.

elena: applying: `echo 500 > /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/alpha-sim/blkio.weight` (soft).

sara: monitoring p95/p99...

aj: after throttle+migration: p99 dropped to ~640ms within 2m, p95 back to ~220ms. NVMe %util dropped from 96% to 42%.

oncall: customer impact: two streaming customers (alpha-corp, beta-llm) experienced stalls and reconnects for ~12 minutes peak window. error rate for /v1/stream_response increased from 0.1% -> 2.8% at peak.

cust-success-john: notifying alpha-corp and beta-llm with high level summary and ETA for follow-up. ticket numbers: #INC-4772 (alpha-corp), #INC-4773 (beta-llm). sending initial message now.

cust-success-john: message sent: "We observed elevated streaming latency and reconnects from ~12:05-12:17 UTC due to shared pool IO contention. Mitigation applied and services stable. We'll follow up with postmortem." :white_check_mark:

sara: continued monitoring. kv cache eviction rate for alpha-sim dropped back to baseline after migration.

elena: created follow-up runbook entry: increase tenant cache cap for alpha-sim (reduce eviction), schedule dedicated pool for heavy batch windows. assigning owner: elena.

oncall: summary for postmortem: root cause = KV cache eviction thrash from alpha-sim causing NVMe writeback saturation; cgroup blkio contention amplified tail latency for streaming path. mitigation = live migrate tenant + soft blkio throttle. impact = p99 SLO breach (~12m), customers briefly affected, CS notified.

mike: recommended long-term fixes: 1) enforce burst QoS on shared pools 2) auto-detect high writeback and auto-isolate noisy tenants 3) add KV cache admission control by tenant.

elena: owner for postmortem: elena, secondary: sara. ETA initial draft by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: :lock: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. channel will remain open for follow-up actions.

sara: :+1: confirming p99 now ~370ms, p95 ~180ms. closing active paging but will keep an eye for 1h.

oncall: handing back to normal ops. thanks team.

mike: logging commands used for triage in the thread for posterity: 
```
# check blkio
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/alpha-sim/blkio.weight
# migrate
./scheduler migrate --tenant alpha-sim --to dedicated-pool-3 --live
# watch iostat
iostat -x 1 10
```

elena: created follow-up ticket in infra board: INFRA-1298 "Auto-isolate high-writeback tenants".

cust-success-john: will reach out to alpha-corp to offer runbook for batch windows and discuss dedicated capacity if needed.

sara: marking postmortem checklist: incident id=3267890123, severity=P2, duration=00:12:10, owners=[elena,sara].

end of thread.
